d: Landmark SETI search targets, interstellar radio broadcasts, and candidate signal coordinates.

gaia-2452378776434477184.x: Target of Frank Drake’s pioneering 1960 Project Ozma SETI search scanning near the 1.420 GHz neutral hydrogen line.

gaia-5164707970261890560.x: Nearby solar analogue scanned alongside Tau Ceti in the 1960 Project Ozma experiment conducted at Green Bank Observatory.

m13-hercules.x: 1,679-bit pictorial radio broadcast transmitted by Frank Drake and Carl Sagan from Arecibo Observatory in 1974 toward Messier 13.

hip-95477.x: Narrowband 1420 MHz radio signal recorded by Jerry Ehman at Ohio State Big Ear radio telescope on 15 August 1977 near the Chi Sagittarii group.

gaia-5853498713190525696.x: Nearest stellar system and subject of intensive Breakthrough Listen monitoring, including the BLC1 candidate narrowband radio detection.

gaia-704967037090946688.x: Target of the 2003 Cosmic Call 2 interstellar radio transmission broadcast from the Evpatoria RT-70 planetary radar.
